anomalies.observed: J4 is an AVR-ISP-6 connector, but its pin 1 (MISO) is connected to the PWM net (U2.6/U3.6/PB1), while its pin 4 (MOSI) is connected to the SDA net (U2.5/U3.5/PB0).
anomalies.expected: For an ATtiny45/ATtiny13 ISP header, pin 1 MISO should connect to the MCU MISO pin PB0 (U2.5/U3.5), and pin 4 MOSI should connect to the MCU MOSI pin PB1 (U2.6/U3.6). The observed J4 pin 1/4 connections are swapped.

anomalies.impact: If J4 is used as a standard AVR-ISP header, the programmer will drive the MCU's MISO pin and read the MCU's MOSI/PWM pin, so in-circuit programming will fail or conflict with the fan PWM/I2C circuitry.

parsed.summary: The design appears to contain a connectivity anomaly on the AVR-ISP-6 header: its MISO and MOSI pins are swapped relative to the ATtiny MCU pins, preventing normal ISP programming.
